name: false
expr: r1 = double(false); t2 = false(2,2); r2 = double(t2(1)); n2 = numel(t2); t3 = false(3); r3 = double(t3(1)); n3 = numel(t3);
comment: Sig: r = false(...). false()=0; false(2,2) is a 2x2 logical zero matrix (numel 4); false(3) is 3x3 (numel 9), every element 0. Indexing goes through a temp var (t2(1)) because MATLAB rejects chained indexing on a call result -- false(2,2)(1) is 'Invalid array indexing' in MATLAB (numkit allows it). namespace=builtin.
